# The 2024 stylelint recursion workaround is not the accepted extension list

1552 adds an empty extension to the stylelint config to fix recursion. Accepted stylelint.yml instead lists css and scss, while the comm wrapper supplies its working-directory and ignore-path handling. Preserve this as a dated tooling fix; neither its historical empty extension nor the inspected wrapper proves the tool’s current traversal without running it. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: tools/lint/stylelint.yml.
